after_fight.line: Three of them, and not a scratch on you. All right, monsieur.

first.line: Isabelle Moreau. I find people, and I keep people alive. I don't work for strangers.

choices.label: Hargreaves vouches for me
choices.line: Tom Hargreaves is coming. Ask him about me.

choices.label: You saw Freddie's office
choices.line: You saw how it went at Freddie's office.
